articles.summary: WILMINGTON, N.C., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Live Oak Bancshares, Inc. (NYSE: LOB) (“Live Oak” or the “Company”) announced the pricing of an underwritten offering of 4,000,000 depositary shares, each representing a 1/40th ownership interest in a share of 8.750% Fixed Rate Series B Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock (the “Series B Preferred Stock”), with a liquidation preference of $25 per depositary share. When, as and if declared by the board of directors of Live Oak, dividends will be payable on the Series B Preferred Stock from the date of issuance at a rate of 8.750% per annum, payable quarterly in arrears on March 15, June 15, September 15, and December 15 of each year, beginning on December 15, 2026. Live Oak may, at its option, redeem the Series B Preferred Stock on any dividend payment date on or after December 15, 2031, or following a regulatory capital treatment event as described in the prospectus supplement and accompanying prospectus relating to the offering,

articles.summary: The Bridging the Dream Scholarship Program Provides $10,000 Scholarships to 30 High School Seniors and 20 Graduate Students Nationwide In celebration of National Scholarship Month, Sallie today announced the newest recipients of its Bridging the Dream Scholarship Program. The Sallie Mae Fund, in partnership with the Thurgood Marshall College Fund (TMCF), awarded $500,000 in scholarships to help students access and complete higher education. Through this year’s program, 30 high school seniors received $10,000 scholarships based on financial need, academic achievement, leadership, and service. In addition, 20 graduate students pursuing advanced degrees also received $10,000 scholarships. Since 2021, The Sallie Mae Fund has awarded more than $5.5 million in scholarships to nearly 1,500 students through its Bridging the Dream and Completing the Dream Scholarship Programs . "Making higher education more accessible and affordable means helping students and families use every resource
articles.title: Sallie Awards $500,000 in Scholarships to Help Students Advance Their Education and Career Goals
